package lesson

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"regexp"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/contentaccess"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

var materialStackPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`)

// LessonMaterialTask combines a public Task with its assessment questions.
type LessonMaterialTask struct {
	Task  domain.Task
	Tests []domain.TaskTest
}

// RelatedLessonMaterial is one authored Lesson relation and its student-facing target content.
type RelatedLessonMaterial struct {
	Relation domain.LessonRelation
	Lesson   map[string]any
	Examples []domain.LessonExample
	Tasks    []LessonMaterialTask
}

// RelatedExampleMaterial is one authored Example relation and its complete target Example.
type RelatedExampleMaterial struct {
	Relation domain.LessonExampleRelation
	Example  domain.LessonExample
}

// LessonMaterials is the read model used while a student reads one Lesson.
type LessonMaterials struct {
	Lesson          map[string]any
	Stack           string
	Examples        []domain.LessonExample
	Tasks           []LessonMaterialTask
	RelatedLessons  []RelatedLessonMaterial
	RelatedExamples []RelatedExampleMaterial
}

// GetLessonMaterials aggregates existing Lesson and Example relations without adding a new authoring contract.
type GetLessonMaterials struct {
	Lessons          repository.LessonRepository
	LessonRelations  repository.LessonRelationRepository
	Examples         repository.LessonExampleRepository
	ExampleRelations repository.LessonExampleRelationRepository
	Tasks            repository.TaskRepository
	TaskTests        repository.TaskTestRepository
	Access           contentaccess.Service
}

// Handle returns active materials for one Lesson, optionally narrowed to one relation stack.
func (uc GetLessonMaterials) Handle(ctx context.Context, lessonID, stack string) (*LessonMaterials, error) {
	lessonID = strings.TrimSpace(lessonID)
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(lessonID); err != nil || !uc.valid() {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	rootReadDecision, err := uc.Access.AuthorizeLesson(ctx, lessonID, "")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	stack = strings.TrimSpace(stack)
	if stack != "" && !materialStackPattern.MatchString(stack) {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}

	root, err := uc.Lessons.Get(ctx, lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if root.Status != domain.LessonStatusActive {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	lessonView, err := uc.Lessons.GetWithFields(
		ctx,
		lessonID,
		queryfields.Parse("", queryfields.LessonAllowedFields),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	applyReadDecision(lessonView, rootReadDecision)

	examples, err := uc.Examples.ListByLesson(ctx, lessonID, true)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	examples = activeExamples(examples)
	tasks, err := uc.lessonTasks(ctx, lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	lessonRelations, err := uc.LessonRelations.ListBySourceLesson(ctx, lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	relatedLessons := make([]RelatedLessonMaterial, 0)
	for _, relation := range lessonRelations {
		if !matchesRelationStack(relation.PrimaryStack, relation.Stacks, stack) {
			continue
		}
		targetReadDecision, err := uc.Access.AuthorizeLesson(ctx, relation.TargetLessonID, relation.ID)
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) || errors.Is(err, domain.ErrForbidden) {
				continue
			}
			return nil, err
		}
		target, err := uc.Lessons.Get(ctx, relation.TargetLessonID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if target.Status != domain.LessonStatusActive {
			continue
		}
		targetView, err := uc.Lessons.GetWithFields(
			ctx,
			relation.TargetLessonID,
			queryfields.Parse("", queryfields.LessonAllowedFields),
		)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		applyReadDecision(targetView, targetReadDecision)
		targetExamples, err := uc.Examples.ListByLesson(ctx, relation.TargetLessonID, true)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		targetExamples = filterExamplesByStack(activeExamples(targetExamples), stack)
		targetTasks, err := uc.lessonTasks(ctx, relation.TargetLessonID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		relatedLessons = append(relatedLessons, RelatedLessonMaterial{
			Relation: relation,
			Lesson:   targetView,
			Examples: targetExamples,
			Tasks:    targetTasks,
		})
	}

	relatedExamples := make([]RelatedExampleMaterial, 0)
	for _, example := range examples {
		relations, err := uc.ExampleRelations.ListBySourceExample(ctx, example.ID, true)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		for _, relation := range relations {
			if !matchesRelationStack(&relation.PrimaryStack, relation.Stacks, stack) {
				continue
			}
			if err := uc.Access.RequireExample(ctx, relation.TargetExampleID, relation.ID); err != nil {
				if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
					continue
				}
				return nil, err
			}
			target, err := uc.Examples.Get(ctx, relation.TargetExampleID)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			if target.Status != domain.LessonExampleStatusActive {
				continue
			}
			targetLesson, err := uc.Lessons.Get(ctx, target.LessonID)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			if targetLesson.Status != domain.LessonStatusActive {
				continue
			}
			relatedExamples = append(relatedExamples, RelatedExampleMaterial{
				Relation: relation,
				Example:  *target,
			})
		}
	}

	return &LessonMaterials{
		Lesson:          lessonView,
		Stack:           stack,
		Examples:        examples,
		Tasks:           tasks,
		RelatedLessons:  relatedLessons,
		RelatedExamples: relatedExamples,
	}, nil
}

func applyReadDecision(lessonView map[string]any, decision contentaccess.LessonReadDecision) {
	lessonView["effective_read_access"] = decision.Effective
	lessonView["can_read"] = decision.CanRead
	if decision.SourceType != "" {
		lessonView["read_access_source_type"] = decision.SourceType
	}
}

func (uc GetLessonMaterials) valid() bool {
	return uc.Lessons != nil && uc.LessonRelations != nil && uc.Examples != nil &&
		uc.ExampleRelations != nil && uc.Tasks != nil && uc.TaskTests != nil && uc.Access.Configured()
}

func (uc GetLessonMaterials) lessonTasks(ctx context.Context, lessonID string) ([]LessonMaterialTask, error) {
	tasks, err := uc.Tasks.ListByLesson(ctx, lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	result := make([]LessonMaterialTask, 0, len(tasks))
	for _, task := range tasks {
		if task.Status != domain.TaskStatusActive {
			continue
		}
		tests, err := uc.TaskTests.ListByTask(ctx, task.ID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if tests == nil {
			tests = make([]domain.TaskTest, 0)
		}
		result = append(result, LessonMaterialTask{Task: task, Tests: tests})
	}
	return result, nil
}

func activeExamples(examples []domain.LessonExample) []domain.LessonExample {
	result := make([]domain.LessonExample, 0, len(examples))
	for _, example := range examples {
		if example.Status == domain.LessonExampleStatusActive {
			result = append(result, example)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func filterExamplesByStack(examples []domain.LessonExample, stack string) []domain.LessonExample {
	if stack == "" {
		return examples
	}
	result := make([]domain.LessonExample, 0, len(examples))
	for _, example := range examples {
		if matchesRelationStack(example.PrimaryStack, example.Stacks, stack) {
			result = append(result, example)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func matchesRelationStack(primary *string, stacks []string, stack string) bool {
	if stack == "" {
		return true
	}
	if primary != nil && *primary == stack {
		return true
	}
	for _, item := range stacks {
		if item == stack {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
